customManagers.description: fallow is installed as a global CLI in its workflow, so no manifest declares it and no other manager can see the pin.

packageRules.description: The Renovate action pins a full semver tag because it publishes no floating major, so it can only stay current if Renovate updates it here.
One toolchain, released in lockstep. oxfmt is pre-1.0, so its minor bumps arrive as majors and land in their own PR.
The unjs trio the tool is built on: config loading, CLI parsing and TS runtime.

The types have to describe the oldest runtime in `engines`, not the newest release, or the build accepts APIs that are missing at run time. `engines.node` is `>=26.0.0`, so the cap is the next major after it — raising the cap without raising the floor is what this rule exists to prevent.
The only published yalc release is a prerelease, so the exact pin is deliberate.
`engines.node` is the support floor this package promises its consumers. Raising it drops runtimes, which is a release decision rather than a dependency update.
